brief:
Khalaf Al Habtoor, an Emirati business figure, has called for forming an Arab committee to reconstruct Gaza rather than waiting for Western assistance, Shehab Wire reported. Al Habtoor emphasized that Arabs possess the financial resources and expertise necessary to restore dignified living conditions for Gaza's residents.

The remarks reflect a push within some Gulf business circles for regional states to take the lead on Gaza reconstruction efforts without depending on international donors.

title: UAE businessman calls Arab states to rebuild Gaza independently
